name: labs/laristizabal1__pv-emulator
title: EA-PS 10060-170 programmable DC source (PV emulator)
intro: EA-PS 10060-170 programmable DC source (PV emulator), adapted from laristizabal1/pv-emulator. It reads `voltage`, `current`, `power` and `error_code`; sets `voltage_setpoint`, `current_setpoint` and `output`; runs `output_off`. `output_off`: switch the DC output off (OUTP OFF); this action is the safe state and takes no input. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
